name: cocon-npm-tools
//: The image's global npm tools (cocon/Dockerfile, stage npm-tools): npm ci from this lockfile,
install scripts off. Renovate bumps the versions and the lockfile. playwright is for the
playwright extra's install-deps step and stays off PATH. corepack: Node 25+ dropped the bundled one.
allowScripts: the only packages whose install scripts the build runs (npm rebuild in the
Dockerfile names the same ones). @anthropic-ai/claude-code: its postinstall (install.cjs)
links the platform package's native binary over the bin/claude.exe stub; it runs nothing
